en: good night (said to one person, m.)
God be with you (said when someone's leaving)
wow! (admiring something — also said to ward off envy/the evil eye)
thank you for your work/effort (said to someone who just did something for you)
enjoy! (said to someone eating, or after a haircut/shower)
what's with this talk? (expressing disbelief at what was just said)
so-so, getting by (response to "how are you")
thank God (also just means "I'm fine" as a response to how-are-you)
what's past is dead — let bygones be bygones, don't dwell on the past
parents see their own kids as perfect (lit. "to its mother, a monkey looks like a gazelle")
everything is nice in its own time — a call for patience
oh my God, oh Lord (exclamation of worry, surprise, or exasperation)
may God have mercy on him (said after mentioning someone who has died)
may it be your turn next (said to someone at a wedding or celebration)
I hope it's good news (said when someone looks worried, or gets a sudden call)
don't mention it, no problem at all (dismissing thanks)
good neighbors matter more than the house itself (lit. "the neighbor before the house")
patience is the key to relief
you really annoyed/frustrated me (lit. "you burned my blood")
I'm so done / so embarrassed / exhausted (lit. "I want to die", exaggerated for effect, not literal)
you scared me (lit. "you gave me a heart attack")
what a terrible day (lit. "oh my black day") — exclamation of distress or bad luck
you talk too much / you're being disrespectful (lit. "your tongue is long")
oh no, I'm ruined (exclamation of distress or exasperation)
I can't think straight, I'm losing it (lit. "my mind is gone")
one day as a rooster beats ten as a hen — dignity and independence over a long life of submission
one hand alone can't clap — you need others to get things done
a burden shared is a burden carried (lit. "a load, once split up, gets lifted")

ar: البعيد عن العين بعيد عن القلب
ar_full: البعيد عن العين بعيد عن القلب
en: out of sight, out of mind
strike the iron while it's hot — seize the opportunity now
too much nagging/blame drives loved ones apart
making peace beats any judgment — reconciliation is best
whoever is too afraid, fails — fortune favors the bold
every rise is followed by a fall — things that go up must come down (said both as caution and as comfort during hard times)

ar: رغيف في رغيف ولا يبات جارك جعان
ar_full: رغيف في رغيف ولا يبات جارك جعان
translit: ra8eef fi ra8eef wala ybaat jaarak ja3aan
en: don't let your neighbor go hungry (lit. "share your bread")
I take a photo, I photograph
I look for, I search for
also, too (⁦كمان⁩ kamaan is more common in casual speech)
a third · also used for "20 minutes" (1/3 of an hour)
one of the first sentences I learned
I have control over my body.
Shall we study on the weekend?
I started walking in the wrong direction.
